hypothesis: The cart completion lock is the in-memory locking provider, which only serialises inside one server process. Completing the same cart simultaneously on two servers lets both run the workflow, which can create two orders or conflicting results for one cart.

hypothesis: createReservationItems_ reads inventory levels, then writes reserved_quantity = level.reserved_quantity + adjustment from the earlier read. Many carts completed concurrently on two servers (separate processes, no shared lock) on WIDGET lose updates, so reserved_quantity diverges from the sum of reservations, and the availability check may allow oversell.
